en:
Hey, Tsumugi.
I don't know much about cosplay...

but it's basically like bringing a fictional
character to life, right?
Yeah, well...that's correct.
Hm...
Wh-What? Why do you look so bothered?

I don't really get why you'd go through all
that just to bring a character to life.

Well, I guess I always wanted to be a cool
hero or princess.

I can see why you'd wanna wear their clothes.
As a kid, I wanted to dress like a princess.

Yeah, that's right! That's why people want 
to try cosplaying!
Sorry, I don't.
You don't!?
H-How mean... You betrayed my feelings!?
B-Betrayed!?

You don't...understand cosplay after all.
Geez, I thought it was just plain obvious.
What do you mean, I don't understand?

Oh, don't worry about it. I'm not mad 
or anything.

Umm...why do I want to become fictional 
characters? If I had to give a reason...umm...
...because they're there?

Why are you treating it as if it's like climbing
a mountain...?

It's the same feeling. It's not a rational 
reason.

You'd feel the same way if someone asked you 
why you like piano, right Kaede?
No, I'd be able to explain.
You'd be able to explain!?

Of course, it's fun to play the piano. But the
real reason I play is to see people smile.

Wh-What a pure answer! Those are, without 
a doubt, the words of a main character...!

A plain background character like me 
can't endure your heroine aura, Kaede.
Heroine aura!?
Wait, that's it! I've got it!
What...?

The reason why you aren't interested 
in becoming fictional characters... It's...

Because being the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL> is already 
pretty fiction-like to begin with!
But I'm real!

...I wanted you to say, "Wh-What did you say!?"
right there. Like you promised.
What promise!?
Aaah! You really are pure!

You're too bright and pure for a corrupted 
denizen of the night like me! Aaaah, bright!

Shouldn't cosplayers be way flashier
than that!?

Kaede, we're pretty in tune. I didn't think 
we'd hang out for so long.
You're pretty in tune yourself, Tsumugi...

Yeah, I think communication like this
is necessary for cosplayers...
Hmm, I guess that is true for cosplayers...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tsumugi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After listening to Tsumugi's cosplay stories, I
parted ways with her and returned to my room.
